description: Hand-curated data for the identity-suspect relation map embedded in analysis/2008-10-31-satoshi-identity-hypotheses-overview (<!-- chart: identity-suspect-map -->). Every edge states a relation DOCUMENTED by the archive; the evidence ids point at the entries that record it. Extracted from the 12 hypothesis + 12 biography pages (2026-07-18 sweep, all 94 candidate evidence ids verified to exist); stylometric ranking comparisons and shared-corpus-exclusion artifacts were deliberately left out — the board shows person-to-person relations only. Node x/y are hand-placed on a 1000x640 viewBox: the documented orbit (cited / contacted, groups A-B of §1) arcs down the right side, the named-by-others crowd (group C) arcs down the left. Edge kinds: cited (whitepaper citation, gold double line) / contact (documented pre-2011 interaction, green solid) / claim (third-party identification, purple dashed) / self (self-claim, magenta solid) / inter (between candidates, slate dotted).
